generation_history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a transparent pixel sprite animation atlas for a preview, not a game integration. Make exactly ONE 4-column by 3-row sheet, 12 equal square cells, read left to right then top to bottom, overall 4:3. Aim for 1536x1152. Image 1 is the exact subject identity reference; Image 2 is only the accepted chibi chunky-pixel animation style reference. Preserve the subject's outfit, hair, skin, distinct eye shape, eye color and small readable mouth, not Nia's face. Large head, short limbs, bold dark outlines, visibly square pixel clusters, limited 3-tone shading, no antialiasing, no painted texture. Body about 52% cell height leaving generous margins for motion and effects. All 12 cells same scale and camera; starting/resting body pivot x=43%, grounded feet baseline y=83%, controlled motion around that pivot, frame12 returns to frame1. Real torso, legs, arms and weapon choreography, no repeated static sprite with only VFX. Crisp full-body character in every cell, face always readable. Keep all effects within each cell, no clipping or overlap. Actual transparent background. No labels, text, numbers, grid lines, scenery, UI or watermark. 8fps, twelve poses for a 1.5s loop.
Nadine / Wolf Assault: a wilderness hunter with orange cap, dark high ponytail and hunting outfit from reference. She plants a foot, raises her bow, releases three distinct arrows with clear hand/string recoil. On the third shot, ONE spectral dark-brown/amber wolf materializes low beside her and leaps forward to the right in a running pounce. She lowers her bow while wolf dissolves. Row1 idle, plant, lift, aim; Row2 release1, re-draw, release2, draw3; Row3 release3/wolf coiled, wolf pounce with hunter leaning, fading wolf/bow recovery, idle.

Identity errata for this fresh generation: retain Nadine's warm brown skin consistently in every pose, dark high ponytail with small pale feather, ochre-orange cap/cape, dark fitted hunting outfit and knee guards from the identity reference. Keep her calm focused face, distinct amber eyes and small readable mouth. Her hunting weapon keeps the compact dark crossbow construction from the identity reference, while preserving the original three-shot and wolf-pounce R choreography above. The one brown/amber spectral wolf must remain compact and low beside her, smaller than the hunter, with all wolf and arrow pixels contained inside its own cell. Keep every other original prompt style, layout and motion instruction above unchanged. Match the original approved Nia pixel-art reference for the drawing language; do not redesign the scene or use newer animation sheets.
